purpose: Verify full mixed strong-form derivatives of a smooth partition-of-unity field before choosing geometry or training a candidate.
hypothesis: The blended field must include window-derivative terms; identical local affine elastic fields must reproduce an exact equilibrium/constitutive patch.
negative_control: Omitting window gradients must be detected on heterogeneous affine local fields, with discrepancy greater than 1e-3.
scope_limit: Manufactured algebraic fields only; does not verify cavity geometry, neural optimization, adaptive allocation, efficiency or novelty.
stop_rule: Do not proceed to geometry or training performance claims if an implementation check fails. Fix and recheck only the failed mechanism.
